remedy_operability_register.harm_or_claim: Old criminal record blocks legal reentry and wealth formation
remedy_operability_register.claimant_perimeter: People with eligible records after sentence completion, waiting periods, dismissal, sealing, expungement, pardon, or clean-slate eligibility
remedy_operability_register.standing_path: Automatic clearance, petition, certificate of relief, licensing appeal, FCRA dispute, anti-discrimination claim
remedy_operability_register.notice_explanation: Notice must tell person what cleared, what remains, and which agencies/vendors must update
remedy_operability_register.interim_protection: Bridge protection during clearance so jobs, licenses, housing, benefits, and schooling are not lost while records update
remedy_operability_register.time_to_relief: Before job, license, housing, school, or benefit denial
remedy_operability_register.review_body: State courts, repositories, licensing boards, employers/vendors, civil-rights or consumer agencies
remedy_operability_register.collective_or_representative_action: Legal aid, reentry organizations, class/vendor enforcement, court or administrative monitoring
remedy_operability_register.restoration_remedy: Clearance, vendor suppression, license/job/housing reconsideration, restoration certificate, damages or penalties
remedy_operability_register.enforcement_actor: Courts, repositories, licensing boards, CRAs/background vendors, civil-rights agencies
